quality_closure.overall_note: Post-release closure of the published v1.0.28 package. The original release verdict (CONDITIONAL PASS, state RELEASED) is unchanged. No confirmed performance regression and no confirmed product defect were found, so no candidate-tree fix is claimed and no emergency v1.0.29 patch is recommended on defect grounds. Retained conditions: the 24-hour soak has not reached 24 hours; Windows, Linux and Intel macOS have no host; the published-binary A/B is INCONCLUSIVE; the historical steer/exit timeout is FLAKY_UNRESOLVED; and 35 of 50 declared gaps remain open.

flake.conclusion: The historical 20 s timeout did not reproduce and the original log was not retained. Code analysis found the steering/admission paths serialized by one mutex; no race was confirmed. No source change and no timeout increase.
